nodes.title: Application Shell
nodes.summary: Owns responsive navigation and the desktop/mobile page frame.

nodes.title: Dashboard
nodes.summary: Projects today's information without owning business records.

nodes.title: Study Timer
nodes.summary: Handles Start, Pause, and manual additions to total daily study time.

nodes.title: Project Planning
nodes.summary: Portfolio and Project Detail views for Project → optional Workstream → Task planning.

nodes.title: Daily Routine
nodes.summary: Weekday operating templates copied into historically stable daily instances.

nodes.title: Habits
nodes.summary: Recurring behaviors with daily evidence and a contribution-style consistency view.

nodes.title: Calendar
nodes.summary: Full-screen ten-week planning for Events, Workstream spans, and Task spans or deadlines.

nodes.title: Caffeine intake
nodes.summary: Intake records projected as a scrollable time-varying estimated body load.

nodes.title: Settings
nodes.summary: Device-local bedtime, residual target, caffeine half-life, and chart display preferences.

nodes.title: Neon Backend
nodes.summary: Groups the Auth, Data API, and RLS-backed Postgres boundary.

nodes.title: Neon Auth
nodes.summary: Owns real user sessions and provides authenticated JWTs.

nodes.title: Neon Data API
nodes.summary: Carries authenticated PostgREST-compatible queries to Postgres.

nodes.title: study_sessions
nodes.summary: Durable timed and manually added study intervals protected by owner-only RLS.

nodes.title: subjects
nodes.summary: Global user-managed academic subjects optionally referenced by Workstreams and Study events.

nodes.title: projects
nodes.summary: Long-running outcomes with explicit status, dates, D-Day, and sibling position.

nodes.title: workstreams
nodes.summary: Optional Project subdivisions with an optional reusable Subject reference.

nodes.title: tasks
nodes.summary: Required Project children with optional Workstream, explicit status, and required due date.

nodes.title: routine templates & instances
nodes.summary: Weekday definitions and copied daily completion records protected by RLS.

nodes.title: habit definitions & completions
nodes.summary: Recurring behavior definitions and one completion record per date.

nodes.title: events
nodes.summary: Timed and all-day calendar records with optional Study subjects.

nodes.title: caffeine intakes & presets
nodes.summary: Dose history plus reusable owner-defined drink and tablet presets.

nodes.title: Vercel Deployment
nodes.summary: Hosts the StudyOS PWA over HTTPS for Mac and iPhone access.

edges.summary: Device-local bedtime, bedtime residual target, half-life, and axis-label preferences drive Caffeine calculations and display.

edges.label: observes session
edges.summary: The root Auth provider makes the current Neon session available to application UI.

edges.label: supplies JWT
edges.summary: The shared Neon client automatically attaches the current Auth JWT to Data API requests.

edges.label: provides
edges.summary: Managed Better Auth is the identity service within the Neon backend.

edges.label: will write
edges.summary: Once the study-session slice exists, completed and manual intervals will use the authenticated Data API boundary.

edges.label: RLS query
edges.summary: Data API access to study sessions is restricted by PostgreSQL ownership policies.

edges.label: CRUD
edges.summary: Project, Workstream, Task, and Subject management use the authenticated Data API client.

edges.label: RLS query
edges.summary: Subject access is restricted to the sole authenticated owner.

edges.label: owner-only RLS
edges.summary: Project access is restricted to the authenticated owner.

edges.label: owns
edges.summary: Each Workstream belongs to exactly one Project.

edges.label: owns
edges.summary: Each Task belongs to exactly one Project, either directly or through a matching Workstream.

edges.label: optionally groups
edges.summary: A Task may belong to one Workstream within its Project.

edges.label: optional Subject
edges.summary: A Workstream may reuse a global Subject; non-academic Workstreams keep this null.

edges.label: CRUD and snapshot RPC
edges.summary: Routine uses public Data API operations; snapshot identity is resolved behind a private JWT helper.

edges.label: owner-only RLS
edges.summary: Routine records are restricted to the JWT owner without granting auth-schema access.

edges.label: CRUD
edges.summary: Habit definitions and daily check-offs use authenticated Data API operations.

edges.label: RLS query
edges.summary: Habit records are available only to the configured owner.

edges.label: CRUD
edges.summary: Calendar event operations use the authenticated Data API boundary.

edges.label: RLS query
edges.summary: Event records are available only to the configured owner.

edges.label: CRUD
edges.summary: Caffeine intake and custom preset records use authenticated Data API operations.

edges.label: RLS query
edges.summary: Caffeine intake and preset records are available only to the configured owner.

edges.label: hosts
edges.summary: Vercel serves the built StudyOS PWA over a stable HTTPS origin.
